description: Generate our branded PNG result card with a working result QR code in 4:5 or 9:16. Returns the image directly plus a download URL; no browser screenshot is required. Works with compatible result links from any domain and all twelve languages. Profile matches use the current 12axes.cc catalogue.

attempt_id.description: Forward the random attempt_id from this quiz to connect operational events. Never use a score or category as this ID.

result_url.description: An actual compatible 12 Axes result link from any domain, a relative path, or its query parameters. Requires v with twelve scores or est/rep/pod/imi/dip/int/eco/con/com/rel/mor/tec. A homepage, image filename or placeholder is not a result. Only encoded data is read.

name: axes_generate_share_card
title: Generate a 12 Axes share image
